summary.title: LocateAnything: Fast and High-Quality Vision-Language Grounding with Parallel Box Decoding

details: VLMs serialize each 2D box into 1D coordinate tokens decoded strictly sequentially, creating a latency/throughput bottleneck and ignoring the coupled geometry of (x1,y1,x2,y2).
Generic multi-token-prediction remedies chunk tokens arbitrarily, cutting across box and category boundaries, which harms accuracy and reliability.

Parallel Box Decoding (PBD): align multi-token-prediction blocks with geometric units so an entire bounding box (or point) is emitted as one atomic fixed-length block in a single forward step, with bidirectional attention within a block and causal attention across blocks.

Joint dual-formulation training that optimizes the same ground truth simultaneously as a causal NTP stream and a block-masked MTP stream, isolated by a specialized heterogeneous attention mask over a shared visual/query context.
On-demand inference: Fast (all-parallel), Slow (NTP), and Hybrid mode that detects format irregularity or spatial ambiguity in a parallel block and re-decodes only that block autoregressively.

Moon-ViT native-resolution encoder + MLP projector + Qwen2.5 LM decoder (LocateAnything-3B); coordinates normalized to [0,1000] and quantized; block length L=6 with <null> padding and four block types (Semantic, Box, Negative, End).

Two base-VLM stages for world-knowledge alignment (no detection data), then Stage-3 SFT on the full 138M-query grounding mixture (lr 4e-5, max seq len 25,600) and Stage-4 dense-detection emphasis (general data cut to 20%, more MOT20Det/SKU110K, lr 1e-5).
Infrastructure: online stream packing (~36,864-token batches, best-fit heuristic, >95% efficiency) plus MagiAttention for heterogeneous packed masks.

Inference: nucleus sampling (T=0.7, top-p 0.9), repetition penalty 1.1, KV cache with truncation to committed tokens, BF16, batch size 1; ambiguity trigger when top-1 coordinate prob < 0.7 and top-5 coordinate spread > 80/1000.

12M images, 138M queries, 785M boxes across six task families (general detection 66.9% of queries, GUI grounding 16.5%, referring, text localization, layout, pointing); >22M negative (abstain) samples.

Data engine: Qwen3-VL synthesizes object-centric queries from detection GT (Open Images, Objects365) with Molmo point verification inside GT boxes; for unlabeled images (Unsplash, SA-1B) queries drive Molmo+SAM 3 or Rex-Omni boxes, post-verified by Qwen3-VL.
Detection: COCO, LVIS, VisDrone, Dense200; grounding: RefCOCOg, HumanRef; GUI: ScreenSpot-Pro; documents/text: DocLayNet, M6Doc, TotalText; point-based tasks scored by point-in-mask/box.
Metric: F1 at IoU 0.5, 0.95 and mean over thresholds; throughput as boxes per second (BPS) on one H100, batch size 1, measured on COCO.

Baselines: specialized detectors (DETR, Deformable-DETR, Grounding DINO, DocLayout-YOLO, PaddleOCRv5), generalist VLMs (Qwen3-VL, DeepSeek-VL2, OVIS2.5, MiMo-VL, SEED1.5-VL), VLM grounding specialist Rex-Omni, and GUI expert models.

concrete_detailed_setting.aspect: Ablations (COCO-only training to isolate the decoding design)
details: Coordinate representation: textual digits vs. quantized tokens vs. PBD.
MTP formulation: structure-agnostic SDLM (block sizes 4/6/8) and Block Diffusion vs. box-aligned PBD.
Loss/mode ablation: NTP-only vs. block-only vs. joint loss; Fast/Hybrid/Slow decoding.
Box output ordering (X-Y corner, center distance, area, random) and throughput vs. number of target boxes (20 to 300); backbone transfer to Qwen3-VL-4B.

key_findings.finding: Box-aligned parallel decoding beats both sequential coordinate decoding and structure-agnostic MTP on accuracy and throughput simultaneously.
key_findings.evidence: On COCO-only ablations, PBD in Slow Mode reaches 52.1 mean F1 vs. 49.1 (textual digits) and 50.1 (quantized tokens) under NTP; against MTP baselines, PBD Fast gets 49.6 F1 at 16.9 BPS whereas SDLM-B6 achieves only 46.1 F1 at 5.5 BPS, and larger structure-agnostic block sizes degrade F1 with marginal speed gains.

key_findings.finding: Hybrid decoding with localized NTP fallback resolves the speed-accuracy trade-off of parallel decoding.
key_findings.evidence: On COCO ablations Hybrid attains 51.6 F1 at 13.2 BPS versus Fast Mode 16.9 BPS with accuracy drops and Slow Mode 52.1 F1; in full-model reporting Hybrid runs at 12.7 BPS versus Fast 15.3 BPS while keeping precision close to the Slow-Mode upper bound (e.g., 55.1 COCO F1@mIoU, 79.8 DocLayNet).

key_findings.finding: The joint NTP+block dual-formulation training is necessary: it raises accuracy beyond training with either loss alone.
key_findings.evidence: Ablation on decoding-mode/loss shows joint training pushes the Slow-Mode upper bound from 50.1 to 52.1 F1, whereas isolated losses cap performance.

key_findings.finding: LocateAnything advances the speed-accuracy frontier over prior VLM grounding systems at equal model size.
key_findings.evidence: Hybrid Mode achieves 12.7 BPS, ~10x Qwen3-VL's 1.1 BPS and 2.5x Rex-Omni's 5.0 BPS, while improving mean F1 by +3.8 on LVIS and +1.8 on COCO over Rex-Omni, 39.9 vs. 35.8 on VisDrone, 76.8 (DocLayNet) and 70.1 (M6Doc), 60.3 on ScreenSpot-Pro, and 78.7 on HumanRef.
